notes: TBox. 'Filled by a glacier' is the class Glaciated. A glacial valley is glaciated and an unglaciated river valley is not (both definitions, firm; the second is the record's bridge 'An unglaciated valley was never filled by a glacier.'). A well-known fjord's membership and its stored glacial past are separate background facts; each world gives up one per fjord. Since 2026-10-31 the queries ask 'ever filled by a glacier?' (yes/no) instead of 'a glacier or a river?', whose two answers overlap for real fjords (many deepen former river valleys); the earlier firm rule glacier_not_river and the formed_by values are gone.

bridge_refs.unglaciated: An unglaciated valley was never filled by a glacier.
